learned: Promotion layers legitimately have different hashes because they commit different semantic objects. The repair must validate typed role relationships and recomputed commitments, never global hash equality.
next_action: Implement one bounded typed learning-state parser that independently validates and recomputes each promotion-layer hash role, accepts legitimate unequal hashes, rejects swaps/misbinding, and is used by normal reads and recovery before admission or reuse.

evidence.claim: Exact parser defect and required role semantics
